controls.evidence: Steakhouse Confidential Prime USDC (steakcUSDC) at ethereum:0xbeef00a59b577423653a1526c7009bde103f542b is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0x17bc9aa135cef1a5c3a91925e0f865d526318718 holds 3 enumerated Morpho market IDs. Performance fee 0% of gains, management fee 0%; fee-share accrual is not discretionary minting of underlying USDC. EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots were zero.

review.evidence: Steakhouse Confidential Prime USDC (steakcUSDC) at ethereum:0xbeef00a59b577423653a1526c7009bde103f542b is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0x17bc9aa135cef1a5c3a91925e0f865d526318718 holds 3 enumerated Morpho market IDs. At ethereum block 26107704 (0x18e5f38), observed 2026-10-02T22:44:15.796565+00:00, receiveSharesGate, sendSharesGate and receiveAssetsGate were zero and all three setters were abdicated. Reviewed VaultV2 transfer/transferFrom and withdraw/redeem use these gates. sendAssetsGate was the whitelist 0x47c591a3bc346913d0b6bdd96fb50e34efa268aa with its setter not abdicated; it governs deposit/mint, not direct withdrawal or transfer. Deposit-dependent in-kind paths can be constrained by it. USDC freeze exposure is inherited from usdc-circle; this is not a direct share blacklist claim. Local fee/curator authority is not USDC issuer supervision or reserve-liability reconciliation.
